artifact_disclaimer: These artifacts are derived from Epoch AI's PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVE SAMPLE TRANSCRIPTS (5 published sample problems). They are NOT the FrontierMath benchmark. FrontierMath is a private held-out problem set that is not distributed. No number computed from these samples is a FrontierMath score, an approximation of one, or a lower/upper bound on one. The sample corpus contains no ground-truth answers and no grader verdicts.
not_a_substitute: GSM8K, MATH / MATH-500, MathArena, AIME sets, and any other public math benchmark are NOT substitutes for FrontierMath. A score on any of them is not a FrontierMath score.

gradability.gradable_locally_reason: The public sample corpus carries no ground-truth answers and no grader verdicts. Correctness cannot be computed. Even with ground truth, five published sample problems are not the FrontierMath benchmark.

score_refusal_reason: Fail-closed: this module never emits a score for frontiermath_eval. See gradability.gradable_locally_reason.
